station_specific_bundles.claim_boundary: This is a local operational/scenario matrix with hazard and control text. It is not a synchronized sensor record or an observed accident dataset.
The sequence logs support operational-state replay. They do not attest a vehicle-side fill or an independently calibrated physical unit system.

station_specific_bundles.provenance_note: The workbooks describe graph-recovered or restored trend values in their own metadata; treat them as reconstructed trend evidence until raw logger provenance is attested.
station_specific_bundles.claim_boundary: Reconstructed trend values must not be presented as raw calibrated logger data.
Channel units and sensor calibration remain a custodian-attestation item.

station_specific_bundles.claim_boundary: Recovered spreadsheet channels require provenance and calibration review before quantitative fitting.
Documents and drawings provide design/context evidence, not measured dynamic validation.

coverage_assessment.main_limit: The local collection is rich in station-side telemetry, operational sequences, qualitative hazard controls and engineering context, but synchronized vehicle pressure/temperature/SOC/delivered-mass channels are not yet attested as one independent full-loop cohort.

recommended_next_steps: Use the 52-step local scenario matrix to cross-check HAZOP action coverage and virtual command mappings without copying raw hazard text into the public repository.
Use the 10-cycle operation logs as a sequence holdout only after channel units and cycle provenance are signed off by the custodian.
Use minute/recovered trend workbooks for qualitative trend and persistence checks, keeping reconstructed values separate from raw logger evidence.
Map the engineering reference bundle to de-identified asset classes and zones for 3D/CCTV placement; do not publish drawings, site identity or manufacturer details.
Keep the full-loop validation gate closed until an independent synchronized vehicle-side pressure, temperature, delivered-mass or SOC channel set is attested.
claim_boundary: This privacy-bounded inventory proves that local station-related data are not sparse and identifies defensible uses. It does not publish raw records, reveal the site, certify units, validate safety distances, or close the IJHE full-loop gate.
